In hindsight, I probably should have focused less on past examples in Myanmar and Bosnia (which to be intellectually honest required an immense
amount of effort and political pressure to pull off) and more on smaller, concrete things that USAID officers can do in the future, like:
- Research to see what local laws and regulations governments already have on the books (or are considering) related to platforms.
- Figure out if anyone at your Mission already has contacts with platforms in the country or the region where you work.
- Identify local civilsocietyorganizations who are already working to hold platforms more accountable.
- Support existing or new forums that bring together government, civil society and platforms to discuss platform governance.
- What else am I missing? In terms of low-hanging fruit to get people started?
+ Nadereh andAdam, please chime in too based on your experience.Incase this is usefulfor future sessions on the Disinformation Primer and also for
us at OTI since our projects have smaller timeframes and budgets.
Best,
